# Tasks API reference

[Tasks](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/settings/run-tasks) allow HCP Terraform workspaces to interact with external systems at specific points in the HCP Terraform run lifecycle. Tasks are reusable configurations that you can associate to any workspace in an organization.

HCP Terraform supports two types of task. You identify the type of a task by its `category` attribute.

| Task type | `category` | Description | API reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Run task | `task` or `hook` | Sends a payload to a URL that you host, signed with an HMAC key that you provide. Your service does the work, then calls back into HCP Terraform with a `passed` or `failed` result. You supply a `url` and an optional `hmac-key` when you create the task. | [Run tasks API reference](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/run-tasks) |
| Native task | `native` | Runs an integration that is built into HCP Terraform, so you do not host any service. You choose an integration and supply the parameters it requires, such as an API URL and credentials, instead of a `url` and `hmac-key`. HCP Terraform runs the integration on an agent and determines the result from the outcomes that the integration reports. | [Native tasks API reference](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/native-tasks) |

This page lists the API endpoints that work the same way for all task types, and explains how to associate tasks to workspaces. Refer to the task type's documentation for information on how to create an update that task.

## Endpoint summary

The scope of the API includes the following endpoints:

| Method   | Path                                                 | Action                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|----------|------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `POST`   | `/organizations/:organization_name/tasks`            | Call this endpoint to [create a run task](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/run-tasks#create-a-run-task) or [create a native task](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/native-tasks#create-a-native-task). |
| `GET`    | `/organizations/:organization_name/tasks`            | Call this endpoint to [list tasks](#list-tasks).                                                                                                                                                               |
| `GET`    | `/tasks/:id`                                         | Call this endpoint to [show a task](#show-a-task).                                                                                                                                                             |
| `PATCH`  | `/tasks/:id`                                         | Call this endpoint to [update a run task](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/run-tasks#update-a-run-task) or [update a native task](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/native-tasks#update-a-native-task). |
| `DELETE` | `/tasks/:id`                                         | Call this endpoint to [delete a task](#delete-a-task).                                                                                                                                                         |
| `GET`    | `/tasks/integrations`                                | Call this endpoint to [list integrations](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/native-tasks#list-integrations) for native tasks.                                                                               |
| `POST`   | `/workspaces/:workspace_id/tasks`                    | Call this endpoint to [associate a task to a workspace](#associate-a-task-to-a-workspace).                                                                                                                     |
| `GET`    | `/workspaces/:workspace_id/tasks`                    | Call this endpoint to [list workspace tasks](#list-workspace-tasks).                                                                                                                                           |
| `GET`    | `/workspaces/:workspace_id/tasks/:id`                | Call this endpoint to [show a workspace task](#show-workspace-task).                                                                                                                                           |
| `PATCH`  | `/workspaces/:workspace_id/tasks/:id`                | Call this endpoint to [update a workspace task](#update-workspace-task).                                                                                                                                       |
| `DELETE` | `/workspaces/:workspace_id/tasks/:id`                | Call this endpoint to [delete a workspace task](#delete-workspace-task).                                                                                                                                       |
| `GET`    | `/task-results/:task_result_id`                      | Call this endpoint to [show a task result](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/task-stages-and-results#show-a-task-result).                                                                                   |
| `GET`    | `/task-results/:task_result_id/outcomes`             | Call this endpoint to [list task result outcomes](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/task-stages-and-results#list-task-result-outcomes).                                                                     |
| `GET`    | `/task-result-outcomes/:task_result_outcome_id`      | Call this endpoint to [show a task result outcome](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/task-stages-and-results#show-a-task-result-outcome).                                                                   |
| `GET`    | `/task-result-outcomes/:task_result_outcome_id/body` | Call this endpoint to [download a task result outcome body](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/task-stages-and-results#download-a-task-result-outcome-body).                                                 |

## Required permissions

To interact with tasks on an organization, you need the [Manage Run Tasks permission](/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/permissions/organization#manage-run-tasks). To associate or dissociate tasks in a workspace, you need the [Manage Workspace Run Tasks permission](/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/permissions/workspace#manage-workspace-run-tasks) on that particular workspace.

Your organization must also be entitled to the type of task you work with. Run tasks require the `run-tasks` [feature entitlement](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs#feature-entitlements), and native tasks require the `native-tasks` feature entitlement.

[permissions-citation]: #intentionally-unused---keep-for-maintainers

## List tasks

`GET /organizations/:organization_name/tasks`

Lists the tasks in an organization. The response includes both run tasks and native tasks that your organization is entitled to use. Use the `filter[category]` query parameter to return one type.

| Parameter            | Description                         |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `:organization_name` | The organization to list tasks for. |

| Status  | Response                                | Reason                                                         |
| ------- | --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | [JSON API document][] (`type: "tasks"`) | Request was successful                                         |
| [404][] | [JSON API error object][]               | Organization not found, or user unauthorized to perform action |

### Query parameters

This endpoint supports pagination [with standard URL query parameters](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs#query-parameters). Remember to percent-encode `[` as `%5B` and `]` as `%5D` if your tooling doesn't automatically encode URLs.

| Parameter          | Description                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `filter[category]` | **Optional.** Returns only tasks of this category. Use `task` for run tasks or `native` for native tasks.                                                              |
| `include`          | **Optional.** Allows including related resource data. Value must be a comma-separated list containing one or more of `workspace_tasks` or `workspace_tasks.workspace`. |
| `page[number]`     | **Optional.** If omitted, the endpoint returns the first page.                                                                                                         |
| `page[size]`       | **Optional.** If omitted, the endpoint returns 20 tasks per page.                                                                                                      |

### Sample request

```shell
curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/organizations/my-organization/tasks
```

### Sample response

The attributes of a task depend on its category. A run task (`category: "task"`) includes `url` and `hmac-key`. A native task (`category: "native"`) includes `params` and an `integration` relationship instead. Refer to the [run tasks](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/run-tasks) and [native tasks](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/tasks/native-tasks) pages for each shape.

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "task-7oD7doVTQdAFnMLV",
      "type": "tasks",
      "attributes": {
        "category": "task",
        "name": "my-task",
        "url": "http://example.com",
        "description": "Simple description",
        "enabled": "true",
        "hmac-key": null
      },
      "relationships": {
        "organization": {
          "data": {
            "id": "hashicorp",
            "type": "organizations"
          }
        },
        "tasks": {
          "data": []
        }
      },
      "links": {
        "self": "/api/v2/tasks/task-7oD7doVTQdAFnMLV"
      }
    }
  ],
  "links": {
    "self": "https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/organizations/hashicorp/tasks?page%5Bnumber%5D=1&page%5Bsize%5D=20",
    "first": "https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/organizations/hashicorp/tasks?page%5Bnumber%5D=1&page%5Bsize%5D=20",
    "prev": null,
    "next": null,
    "last": "https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/organizations/hashicorp/tasks?page%5Bnumber%5D=1&page%5Bsize%5D=20"
  },
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "current-page": 1,
      "page-size": 20,
      "prev-page": null,
      "next-page": null,
      "total-pages": 1,
      "total-count": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## Associate a task to a workspace

`POST /workspaces/:workspace_id/tasks`

| Parameter       | Description              |
| --------------- | ------------------------ |
| `:workspace_id` | The ID of the workspace. |

This endpoint associates an existing task to a specific workspace.

When you associate a task, you choose from the following enforcement levels, which determines whether the task blocks a run from completing:

- **Advisory**: Do not block a run from completing. If the task fails, the run proceeds with a warning.
- **Mandatory**: Block the run from completing if task fails, including a timeout or unexpected remote error condition. The run stops with an error.

You can also configure the task to begin during specific [run stages](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/run/states). Tasks use the [Post-Plan Stage](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/run/states#the-post-plan-stage) by default.

| Status  | Response                  | Reason                                                             |
| ------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [204][] | No Content                | The request was successful                                         |
| [404][] | [JSON API error object][] | Workspace or task not found or user unauthorized to perform action |
| [422][] | [JSON API error object][] | Malformed request body                                             |

### Request body

This POST endpoint requires a JSON object with the following properties as a request payload.

Properties without a default value are required.

| Key path                            | Type   | Default         | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
|-------------------------------------|--------|-----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `data.type`                         | string |                 | Must be `"workspace-tasks"`.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `data.attributes.enforcement-level` | string |                 | The enforcement level of the workspace task. Must be `"advisory"` or `"mandatory"`.                                                                                                |
| `data.attributes.stage`             | string | `"post_plan"`   | **DEPRECATED** Use `stages` instead. The stage in the run lifecycle when the task should begin. Must be `"pre_plan"`, `"post_plan"`, `"pre_apply"`, or `"post_apply"`.             |
| `data.attributes.stages`            | array  | `["post_plan"]` | An array of strings representing the stages of the run lifecycle when the task should begin. Must be one or more of `"pre_plan"`, `"post_plan"`, `"pre_apply"`, or `"post_apply"`. |
| `data.relationships.task.data.id`   | string |                 | The ID of the task.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `data.relationships.task.data.type` | string |                 | Must be `"tasks"`.                                                                                                                                                                 |

### Sample payload

```json
{
  "data": {
    "type": "workspace-tasks",
    "attributes": {
      "enforcement-level": "advisory",
      "stages": ["post_plan"]
    },
    "relationships": {
      "task": {
        "data": {
          "id": "task-7oD7doVTQdAFnMLV",
          "type": "tasks"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Sample request

```shell
curl \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json" \
  --request POST \
  --data @payload.json \
  https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/workspaces/ws-PphL7ix3yGasYGrq/tasks
```

### Sample response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "wstask-tBXYu8GVAFBpcmPm",
    "type": "workspace-tasks",
    "attributes": {
      "enforcement-level": "advisory",
      "stage": "post_plan",
      "stages": ["post_plan"]
    },
    "relationships": {
      "task": {
        "data": {
          "id": "task-7oD7doVTQdAFnMLV",
          "type": "tasks"
        }
      },
      "workspace": {
        "data": {
          "id": "ws-PphL7ix3yGasYGrq",
          "type": "workspaces"
        }
      }
    },
    "links": {
      "self": "/api/v2/workspaces/ws-PphL7ix3yGasYGrq/tasks/wstask-tBXYu8GVAFBpcmPm"
    }
  }
}
```

## Update workspace task

`PATCH /workspaces/:workspace_id/tasks/:id`

| Parameter | Description                                                                                                     |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

### Request body

This PATCH endpoint requires a JSON object with the following properties as a request payload.

The `data.type` key path is required. All other properties are optional, and omitted properties keep their previous value.

| Key path                            | Type   | Default          | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
|-------------------------------------|--------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `data.type`                         | string |                  | Must be `"workspace-tasks"`.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `data.attributes.enforcement-level` | string | (previous value) | The enforcement level of the workspace task. Must be `"advisory"` or `"mandatory"`.                                                                                                |
| `data.attributes.stage`             | string | (previous value) | **DEPRECATED** Use `stages` instead. The stage in the run lifecycle when the task should begin. Must be `"pre_plan"` or `"post_plan"`.                                             |
| `data.attributes.stages`            | array  | (previous value) | An array of strings representing the stages of the run lifecycle when the task should begin. Must be one or more of `"pre_plan"`, `"post_plan"`, `"pre_apply"`, or `"post_apply"`. |

### Sample payload

```json
{
  "data": {
    "type": "workspace-tasks",
    "attributes": {
      "enforcement-level": "mandatory",
      "stages": ["post_plan"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Sample request

## Delete workspace task

`DELETE /workspaces/:workspace_id/tasks/:id`

| Parameter | Description                                                                                                           |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The ID of the workspace task to delete. Use the ["List workspace tasks"](#list-workspace-tasks) endpoint to find IDs. |

| Status  | Response                  | Reason                                                           |
| ------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |

| [404][] | [JSON API error object][] | Workspace task not found, or user unauthorized to perform action |

### Sample request

```shell
curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json" \
  --request DELETE \
  https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/workspaces/ws-kRsDRPtTmtcEme4t/tasks/wstask-tBXYu8GVAFBpcmPm
```
